ns2:course.label: Exotic/Wild Animal Diag Path 1
ns2:course.description: Instruction in the performance of necropsy examinations on exotic and wild animals; emphasizes recognition, interpretation, oral presentations and written descriptions of gross and histologic lesions; emphasizes histologic features of lesions. For pathology majors only. May be repeated to a maximum of 10 hours. Prerequisite: PATH 634 and PATH 635; consent of instructor.
